entities.summary: Luigi Rizzo, 1st Count of Grado and Premuda (1887–1951), nicknamed the Sinker (l'Affondatore), was an Italian admiral. He is mostly known for his distinguished service in World War I; as a torpedo boat commander having sunk no fewer than two Austro-Hungarian battleships.
